title: Modern Miracle Men
container: US Senate Document No. 264, 74th Congress, 2nd session (reprinted from Cosmopolitan, June 1936)
note: A magazine article about Dr Charles Northen, printed as a Senate document at the request of Senator Duncan Fletcher. It is a journalist's account, not a Senate report or a scientific study. Magnesium is named once.
access: full text (scanned PDF, GovInfo); excerpts are OCR, so occasional spelling slips come from the scan

excerpts.anchor: Do you know that most of us today are suffering from certain dangerous diet deficiencies

marks: Many backward children are “stupid” merely because they are deficient in magnesia.
